kind: Three prospective assessed-goal payloads; unreviewed and absent from active canonical

goalPayloads.title: Entsorgung und Recycling von Batterien und Akkumulatoren bewerten
goalPayloads.titleEn: Assess disposal and recycling of batteries and accumulators
goalPayloads.description: Die lernende Person kann Entsorgung und Recycling von Batterien und Akkumulatoren an geeigneten Beispielen fachlich diskutieren und anhand der Umweltfolgen begründet bewerten.
goalPayloads.descriptionEn: The learner can discuss disposal and recycling of batteries and accumulators using suitable examples and assess them with reasons based on their environmental consequences.

goalPayloads.title: Gewinnung seltener Metalle für Spannungsquellen diskutieren
goalPayloads.titleEn: Discuss extraction of rare metals for electrochemical sources
goalPayloads.description: Die lernende Person kann die Rohstoffgewinnung seltener Metalle für elektrochemische Spannungsquellen an geeigneten Beispielen fachlich diskutieren.
goalPayloads.descriptionEn: The learner can discuss extraction of rare metals for electrochemical sources using suitable examples and scientific reasoning.

goalPayloads.title: Metallrecycling für Konsum- und Entsorgungsentscheidungen nutzen
goalPayloads.titleEn: Use metal recycling knowledge for consumption and disposal decisions
goalPayloads.description: Die lernende Person kann die Bedeutung des Metallrecyclings für Ressourcenschonung und Energieeinsparung beschreiben und auf dieser Grundlage das eigene Konsum- und Entsorgungsverhalten begründet bewerten.
goalPayloads.descriptionEn: The learner can describe the significance of metal recycling for conserving resources and saving energy and use that account to assess their own consumption and disposal choices with reasons.

scopeAndAssessmentSpecifications.meaning: One contextual environmental judgment about disposal and recycling. Battery and accumulator refer to both non-rechargeable and rechargeable source examples; the scope is not silently reduced to primary cells.
scopeAndAssessmentSpecifications.assessmentCandidate: Use supplied material/composition, collection/recovery and environmental-consequence information for one primary battery and one accumulator. Discuss disposal and recycling consequences and justify context-dependent judgments. No unattended handling, opening, incineration or classroom disassembly is part of this competence.
wrongGeneralizationsToReject: All discarded batteries may be treated like ordinary classroom chemical residues.
Every recycling route is impact-free or always better under every system boundary.
Judging only primary-cell construction covers accumulator disposal and recycling.

scopeAndAssessmentSpecifications.meaning: One material-based discussion of rare-metal extraction for electrochemical sources. This does not require the learner to reconstruct an industrial extraction mechanism or classify every metal as rare.
scopeAndAssessmentSpecifications.assessmentCandidate: Discuss supplied and scientifically adequate information about the extraction of a selected rare metal used for an electrochemical source. State which conclusions the given evidence supports and avoid projecting rare-metal scarcity or impacts onto all metals or all battery types.
wrongGeneralizationsToReject: Rare metal and rare-earth metal are synonyms.
This source requires specific mining or metallurgical reaction mechanisms.
All raw-metal extraction facts automatically prove a complete battery-disposal decision.

scopeAndAssessmentSpecifications.meaning: One knowledge-based personal decision: explain resource/energy significance and use it to assess consumption/disposal. The explanation is the basis of the judgment, not an independent machinery or procedure competence.
scopeAndAssessmentSpecifications.assessmentCandidate: Use a qualitative or simple provided primary-versus-secondary metal-resource/energy comparison with explicit boundaries. Describe why resource conservation and energy saving matter and use both points to justify a consumption/disposal choice. A hypothetical personally chosen example is sufficient; no personal household/learner data is collected or committed.
wrongGeneralizationsToReject: All metal recycling uses zero energy.
A generic environmental opinion without resource/energy reasoning satisfies the whole bullet.
Explaining a concrete recycling process mechanism is required by this competency.
newSourceDutiesNotAdded: All criteria of the broad generic action-decision goal
